        x /= 10;
        ++cnt;
    }
    return cnt;

    for (int i = 0; i < d; ++i) {
        res = res * 10 + 1;

    if (x <= 6) return x;

    ll nextRep = rep * 10 + 1;

        if (x > nextRep / 2) {
            return min(option1, option2);
        }
        return option1;
    }
